• Hey everyone, I just finished my paper and wanted to share what came up. First off, it is entirely on the computer, so don't bother bringing markers or extra stationery like I did. The difficulty was pretty easy if you know the handouts. Just be ready for computer science paragraphs because they use technical texts to test English skills. The synonym for cloak is loose garment. The synonym for somber is grave. Make sure to read carefully so you don't confuse synonyms with antonyms. There was a question about what a big computer system is called. The answer is Mainframe Computer, so do not fall for trick choices like Big PCs. Also, make sure you revise sentence types like simple, compound, and complex, aGood luck to everyone who has their exam next. Let me know if you need any tips.
